risks.if_unproven: Price as used lenses with possible optical wear; assume not guaranteed to be perfect.

proof_requests: Clear close-ups of both lenses showing exact focal length/model markings (front ring + side label).
Clear photo of the Nikon camera model name/number on the body (not just the logo).
A short video recording clip (10–20 seconds) showing autofocus and audio (if applicable).
Two test photos: one sharp at close range and one at far distance; include a shot of the LCD playback.
Photos of all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, hood, strap, memory card if any).
Sensor test shot (white wall at small aperture) or sensor close-up.
response.reason: The photo confirms a Nikon DSLR with two lenses, but the exact camera model and lens focal lengths/models—and their working condition—are not verifiable from the single image. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
